advancements.raft.adventure.every_soul.d: Meet all eight people of the Endless Sea
advancements.raft.adventure.new_friend.d: Talk to one of the people who still live on the Endless Sea
almanac.raft.people.dr_lund.text:
Dr. Elin Lund studies the weather and wildlife of the Endless Sea from her outpost on the ice floes of the far north.
# Trades
She buys jelly, angler lures, shark teeth and leviathan scales and sells diving gear and harpoons.
almanac.raft.people.dr_lund.title: Dr. Elin Lund
almanac.raft.people.dr_voss.text: Dr. Imara Voss, chief scientist of the Meridian Expedition, studies the Tidewarden tablets in the Ashen Forge. She knows how to cross the river of fire, and what to do with the sigils.
almanac.raft.people.dr_voss.title: Dr. Imara Voss
almanac.raft.people.kai.text:
Kai is a cheerful castaway who lives in the castaway camps on the palm isles and waits for a rescue ship.
# Trades
Everything that washes up on his beach, for cookies. He would also love a fishing net.
almanac.raft.people.kai.title: Kai
almanac.raft.people.keeper_fenn.text:
Keeper Tobias Fenn has kept the Old Lighthouse burning for forty years, flood or no flood. He knows the way to Saltmere and gives every newcomer his old spyglass.
# Trades
He buys cod and salmon and sells candles, lanterns, glowstone and spyglasses.
almanac.raft.people.keeper_fenn.title: Keeper Tobias Fenn
almanac.raft.people.nalu.text:
Nalu, the grandson of Nana Kalea, came back to Saltmere to keep the shrine lamps lit. He knows where the Coral Sigil rests and gives castaways a potion for the deep water ahead.
# Trades
Pearls for the crafts of Saltmere: lanterns, rugs, wind chimes and shell lamps. He turns seashells into pearls, too.
almanac.raft.people.nalu.title: Nalu
almanac.raft.people.okafor.text:
Patience Okafor is the last engineer of Rig Seven, the rusted giant on the open sea. She keeps its generators humming and its radio on.
# Trades
Circuit boards, cables, scrap, redstone, titanium and batteries. She buys copper, iron and plastic.
almanac.raft.people.okafor.title: Patience Okafor
almanac.raft.people.old_tamo.text:
Old Tamo fishes from the docks of Saltmere. He never misses a bite, never misses a chance to talk and always pays for a good catch.
# Trades
He buys fish, crab claws and eel and sells fishing rods, sea pickles, glow kelp, boats and the odd nautilus shell.
almanac.raft.people.old_tamo.title: Old Tamo
almanac.raft.people.teo.text:
Teo runs the beach bar on the palm isles and waits for his sweetheart Ana, who was lost on the night of the flood.
# Trades
Drinks and island food. He buys pineapples, coconuts and good rum.
almanac.raft.people.teo.title: Teo
almanac.raft.people.text:
Not everyone left when the sea rose. A few brave or stubborn souls stayed in the old places, and they are glad of every visitor.
Right-click a person to talk. What they say changes as your story goes on, and the story's guides hand you something useful when you first meet them.
# Trading
Some of them trade. The coin of the sea is pirate gold from corsairs, wrecks and treasure, and pearls from giant clams. Many of them also buy what you catch or find.
# They stay
The people of the sea never leave their homes and nothing out here can hurt them. Be kind anyway.
almanac.raft.people.title: People of the Sea
npc.raft.dr_lund.greet.default: The kettle is always on. And if you bring me specimens from the sea, I pay well. Science doesn't stop for a little flood.
npc.raft.dr_lund.greet.done: The currents have changed: warmer, calmer. The penguins are confused and a little offended. So am I. Thank you, though.
npc.raft.dr_lund.greet.first:
Visitors! Close the hatch, you're letting the cold in. Elin Lund, Meridian Expedition, weather and wildlife.
Here, have some tea. Honey helps against the cold.
npc.raft.dr_lund.hurt: Ow! I have frostbite in three toes, I don't need bruises too.
npc.raft.dr_lund.place: This outpost measures the sea: temperature, salt, currents. Since the seal cracked every chart I draw looks wrong. Something huge breathes in the trench, and the whole ocean breathes with it.
npc.raft.dr_lund.rumor.1: The penguins here are very angry little birds. Don't let them see your fish unless you plan to share.
npc.raft.dr_lund.rumor.2: Jellyfish, angler lures, shark teeth: bring them to me and I pay in coin. I am writing the first proper guide to the creatures of the Endless Sea.
npc.raft.dr_lund.rumor.3: Whales sing under the ice at night, long low songs. Sometimes something answers from very far below. That one I don't record.
npc.raft.dr_lund.title: Polar Researcher
npc.raft.dr_voss.greet.after: Four sigils: Coral, Pearl, Storm and Ember. Take them to the Coral Temple on the bright reef floor and set them into its altar. The key will rise from their light.
npc.raft.dr_voss.greet.at: The Ember Sigil waits in the vault beyond the river of fire. Drink the potion before you cross, and don't look down.
npc.raft.dr_voss.greet.done: It's over. The seal is quiet and the sea sleeps. I don't deserve to feel this relieved. But I do. Thank you.
npc.raft.dr_voss.greet.first:
Stay back, I... oh. You're not crew. You're the one from Kalea's songs. I'm Imara Voss. Yes, that Voss. I cracked the Tide Seal.
The Ember Sigil lies in the vault beyond the river of fire. Drink this before you cross. The lava does not forgive a careless step.
npc.raft.dr_voss.greet.first_late: Stay back, I... oh. You're not crew. You're the one from Kalea's songs. I'm Imara Voss. Yes, that Voss. I cracked the Tide Seal. And you are cleaning up after me. Thank you.
npc.raft.dr_voss.greet.key: You forged the key. The Sanctum waits in the trench, and the Sleeper waits inside. Whatever happens down there: thank you for finishing what I broke.
npc.raft.dr_voss.greet.regift: You lost the potion? The lava takes everything it touches. Here, another one. Please be careful this time. I can't lose anybody else.
npc.raft.dr_voss.hurt: I suppose I deserve that. Please don't do it again.
npc.raft.dr_voss.place: The Tidewardens forged their sigils here, in the heat of the mountain. Their tablets explain everything I got wrong. I came to learn how to undo it. The forge lights are mine, if you were wondering.
npc.raft.dr_voss.rumor.1: Port Solace... I went to warn them and came too late. Mayor Crane stayed in his tower to the end and kept the Storm Sigil above the water line. A clever man. A proud man.
npc.raft.dr_voss.rumor.2: Captain Marlow leaves notes for everyone who comes through the portals. She told me not to drill. Everybody should listen to her. I wish I had.
npc.raft.dr_voss.rumor.3: If you see the Leviathan's back break the water, row. It isn't angry. It is just very, very big.
npc.raft.dr_voss.title: Chief Scientist of the Expedition
npc.raft.hint.abyssal_sanctum: Dive into the trench and show the Tide Seal your key. The Abyssal Sanctum lies beyond.
npc.raft.hint.ashen_forge: Find the Ashen Forge on the fire island. The Tidewarden tablets were taken there.
npc.raft.hint.coral_sigil: The Coral Sigil sleeps in Saltmere's shrine, behind the statue of the Tidewarden.
npc.raft.hint.coral_temple: Seek the Coral Temple on the bright reef floor. Its altar remembers the four lights.
npc.raft.hint.done: The sea is calm now. Sail wherever you like, keeper of the tides.
npc.raft.hint.ember_sigil: The Ember Sigil lies beyond the river of fire, in the vault behind the forge. Don't cross without protection from the heat.
npc.raft.hint.helix: Dive to Helix Station on the sea floor below the glowing lagoon. Take a diving helmet and something to breathe.
npc.raft.hint.leviathan: Wake the Leviathan at the altar by the pool and face it on the ring of stone. The whole sea is counting on you.
npc.raft.hint.lighthouse: Your journal knows the way. Follow its chart to the old light on the rocky isle. They say Keeper Fenn still lives there.
npc.raft.hint.pearl_sigil: Doctor Voss locked the Pearl Sigil in the lab vault of Helix Station. Her terminals tell you more.
npc.raft.hint.port_solace: Port Solace sleeps on the drowned shelf. Look for broken towers breaking the waves.
npc.raft.hint.saltmere: Sail for Saltmere, the stilt village where the reef glows at night. The keeper's chart shows the way.
npc.raft.hint.storm_sigil: Climb City Hall, the tallest tower of Port Solace. The Storm Sigil waits in the vault near the top.
npc.raft.hint.tidewarden_key: Set all four sigils into the Tidewarden altar of the Coral Temple. The key will rise from their light.
npc.raft.kai.greet.default: Still here! Still waiting for the rescue ship. Any day now. Got any biscuits?
npc.raft.kai.greet.done: The sea's so calm I can see the fish laughing at me. Hey, can I come with you next time? Just kidding. Unless...?
npc.raft.kai.greet.first: A person! A real person! Hi! I'm Kai! Did you see my SOS? Did you bring biscuits? Please say you brought biscuits.
npc.raft.kai.hurt: Ow! Rude! I'm already stranded, you know.
npc.raft.kai.place: Day forty-something on this island. A seagull stole my last biscuit. I named him Captain Crumbs. We're not on speaking terms. Everything that washes up here, I trade for biscuits.
npc.raft.kai.rumor.1: Bottles wash up here all the time, with letters inside. Sad ones, funny ones. I trade them for biscuits. Everybody needs biscuits.
npc.raft.kai.rumor.2: There are abandoned rafts drifting out there. Some still have crops on them. And chests! Don't ask me how I know.
npc.raft.kai.rumor.3: If you see a light on a rocky island at night, that's the old lighthouse. The keeper waves when he sees you. Well. He waved at me once.
npc.raft.kai.title: Castaway
npc.raft.keeper_fenn.greet.after: Back again? Good. Every time a sail shows up on the horizon I light the lamp a little brighter. Kalea trusted you with her sigil, I hear. Seventy years, and that woman never trusted anybody.
npc.raft.keeper_fenn.greet.at: You'll want Saltmere next, the stilt village where the reef glows. Ask for Nana Kalea. My logbook and a chart are in the desk by the window. Take them, I know the way by heart.
npc.raft.keeper_fenn.greet.done: The sea's gone quiet as a millpond. Forty years I've kept this light and never once saw it like this. Thank you, keeper. The lamp burns for you now.
npc.raft.keeper_fenn.greet.first:
Well now. The portal spat out another one, did it? Welcome to the Endless Sea, castaway. I'm Tobias Fenn, and this light is mine to keep.
Here, take my old spyglass. Out here you want to see the fins before they see you.
npc.raft.keeper_fenn.greet.visited: So you've seen Saltmere. Empty, I suppose. Kalea and her people sailed for higher rocks. Did you read her letters? That woman never wrote a word without a reason.
npc.raft.keeper_fenn.hurt: Easy now! These old bones have weathered worse storms than you.
npc.raft.keeper_fenn.place: This light has burned every night for a hundred years. When the oil runs low I burn driftwood. After the flood a ferry brought forty souls to this rock. They moved on to the high islands. I stayed. Somebody has to keep the light.
npc.raft.keeper_fenn.rumor.1: A lad called Kai built a camp on a palm isle and spelled SOS in stones. Never had the heart to tell him nobody's coming. Except you, maybe.
npc.raft.keeper_fenn.rumor.2: There's an old Meridian rig out on the open sea, standing on four steel legs. Its radio still crackles at night. Sometimes it sounds like singing.
npc.raft.keeper_fenn.rumor.3: Pirate gold? Hah. Saltjaw Brannigan lost the Grinning Gull on the reef of wrecks. They say his crew still guards his treasure in a cove. They say a lot of things.
npc.raft.keeper_fenn.title: Keeper of the Old Light
npc.raft.nalu.greet.after: The sigil is in good hands. Now dive to Helix, Doctor Voss's station on the floor below the glowing lagoon. Wear Grandmother's helmet, and come back to tell me what you find.
npc.raft.nalu.greet.at: The Coral Sigil rests in our shrine, behind the statue of the Tidewarden. Grandmother wants it to go home. Read her letters first. She explains it better than I ever could.
npc.raft.nalu.greet.done: The sea is calm, and Grandmother is coming home. She says the songs have a new verse now. It is about you.
npc.raft.nalu.greet.first:
A stranger with salt in their hair and a chart in their hand. Grandmother said you would come. I'm Nalu. She left her letters for you inside the house.
Take this too. Grandmother brews it from pufferfish and moonlight, for the deep water you will swim through.
npc.raft.nalu.greet.later: The reef sings louder at night since you passed through. The old songs say the tide knows the ones who help it. I think it knows you.
npc.raft.nalu.hurt: Hey! I'm on your side, you know.
npc.raft.nalu.place: Saltmere stands on stilts because the sea gives and the sea takes. When the water rose we sailed for higher rocks. I came back to keep the shrine lamps lit. And to trade a little: pearls for the things our people made.
npc.raft.nalu.rumor.1: Old Tamo is down at the docks. Bring him fish and he pays in coin. Bring him gossip and he talks your ears off.
npc.raft.nalu.rumor.2: Far to the north the sea freezes into floating islands. A doctor of the Expedition lives out there with the penguins. She buys strange things from the sea.
npc.raft.nalu.rumor.3: Some nights a light glows on the fire island where the old forge stands. Nobody should be in there. Grandmother says the old ones made the sigils in that fire.
npc.raft.nalu.title: Grandson of Nana Kalea
npc.raft.okafor.greet.default: The generators hum, the radio crackles and the crane still turns. Need parts? My store room is full of them. I buy good metal, too.
npc.raft.okafor.greet.done: The hum is gone. Do you hear that? Nothing! I've never heard nothing before. It's lovely.
npc.raft.okafor.greet.first:
Hello up there! You climbed all the way up? Nice. Patience Okafor, chief engineer of Rig Seven and the only crew left.
Here, a spare circuit board. Everybody needs one eventually.
npc.raft.okafor.hurt: Hey! I'm holding a live wire here!
npc.raft.okafor.place: Rig Seven drilled for crystal on orders from Port Solace. The deeper we went, the louder the hum got. Then the sea rose and the crew left on the last boat. I stayed. Somebody has to keep the radio on.
npc.raft.okafor.rumor.1: The radio picks up strange things at night. Static that sounds like singing. My log says don't answer it. So I don't. Mostly.
npc.raft.okafor.rumor.2: Port Solace ran its whole grid on crystal power, and the sigils made the crystals sing. Brilliant engineering. Terrible idea.
npc.raft.okafor.rumor.3: A plane went down over the kelp forest, Flight Twelve. The crew made it, the cargo didn't: medicine, tools, tinned peaches. Somebody should go and look.
npc.raft.okafor.title: Engineer of Rig Seven
npc.raft.old_tamo.greet.default: Fish are biting today. Or something is biting them. Either way, I'm buying!
npc.raft.old_tamo.greet.done: Calm water, full nets! You did that? Then the first fish of the season is yours, friend. Well. For a fair price.
npc.raft.old_tamo.greet.first:
Ahoy there! Mind the loose plank. I'm Tamo. Sixty years I've fished these waters and never seen the sea this hungry.
Here, a bit of supper. And bring me your catch: I pay in good pirate gold.
npc.raft.old_tamo.hurt: Oi! Save your fists for the sharks.
npc.raft.old_tamo.place: My granddaughter Mia writes letters to the sea and asks for my old boat back. Ha! The sea can keep it. I built a new one, see? She floats. Mostly.
npc.raft.old_tamo.rumor.1: Watch out for the shark with the notched fin. Bruce, they call him. He bites rafts. Hit him on the nose and he thinks twice.
npc.raft.old_tamo.rumor.2: Down on the drowned shelf there's a whole city under the water, Port Solace. I sold fish at its harbour every Sunday. Now the fish live in the shops.
npc.raft.old_tamo.rumor.3: A fellow called Teo runs a beach bar on the palm isles. Pours a fine pina colada and waits for his sweetheart, every single sunset.
npc.raft.old_tamo.title: Fisherman of Saltmere
npc.raft.teo.greet.default: Pull up a chair! Coconut milk, pina colada, fresh water for the serious ones. Grilled claws if you're hungry.
npc.raft.teo.greet.done: Calm seas! You know what that means? Boats. Boats mean guests. And maybe one day a boat with Ana on it.
npc.raft.teo.greet.first: Welcome to the last bar on the Endless Sea! I'm Teo. The view is free, the music is the waves, and the first drink is on the house.
npc.raft.teo.greet.solace: You've been to Port Solace? Did you see a bakery on Harbour Street, blue shutters? No. Of course not. It's under thirty metres of water. Never mind me.
npc.raft.teo.hurt: Whoa! No bar fights. House rules.
npc.raft.teo.place: Before the flood I mixed drinks in Port Solace. Now I mix them here, on a beach, for crabs and seagulls. The crabs tip better. Bring me pineapples, coconuts or a good bottle of rum and I pay in coin.
npc.raft.teo.rumor.1: Ana was on the evacuation ferry to Saltmere. Or the one to the lighthouse isle. Nobody kept lists that night. So I wait here, where every boat can see my lanterns.
npc.raft.teo.rumor.2: Seagulls steal anything that isn't nailed down. Put a scarecrow near your crops, trust me.
npc.raft.teo.rumor.3: A pirate came by once, soaking wet and grinning. He paid in gold coins as cold as ice and said his captain's treasure lies in a cove where the sea goes in and nothing comes out.
npc.raft.teo.title: Barkeeper of the Beach Bar
